description: Retrieves the list of access control rules (ACLs) for a specified calendar, providing the necessary 'rule_id' values required for updating specific ACL rules.

calendarId.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.
calendarId.human_parameter_description: The calendar you want to view permissions for. Use 'primary' for your main calendar, or paste a specific calendar ID.
calendarId.title: Calendar Id

maxResults.description: Maximum number of entries returned on one result page. Optional. The default is 100.
maxResults.human_parameter_description: How many ACL entries to return per page. Lower this to limit the list, or leave blank to use the default (up to 100).
maxResults.title: Max Results

pageToken.description: Token specifying which result page to return. Optional.
pageToken.human_parameter_description: If continuing from a previous page, paste the token you received to get the next set of results. Leave blank to start from the beginning.
pageToken.title: Page Token

showDeleted.description: Whether to include deleted ACLs in the result. Optional. The default is False.
showDeleted.human_parameter_description: Include ACL rules that have been deleted. Turn this on if you need to see removals for auditing.
showDeleted.title: Show Deleted

syncToken.description: Token obtained from the nextSyncToken field returned on the last page of a previous list operation. It makes the result of this list operation contain only entries that have changed since then. Optional. The default is to retrieve all entries.
syncToken.human_parameter_description: Paste the sync token from a previous list to return only changes since then. Use this for incremental updates instead of fetching everything.
syncToken.title: Sync Token

name: acl_list

display_url.description: URL to view the calendar settings in Google Calendar's interface.
display_url.title: Display Url

etag.description: ETag of the collection, useful for cache validation.
etag.title: Etag

items.description: List of rules on the access control list. May be empty if no rules are present.
items.title: Items

nextPageToken.description: Token used to access the next page of this result. Omitted if no further results are available.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

nextSyncToken.description: Token used at a later point to retrieve only the entries that have changed since this result was returned. Omitted if further results are available.
nextSyncToken.title: Next Sync Token

display_url.description: URL to view this ACL rule in Google Calendar's settings interface.
display_url.title: Display Url

etag.description: ETag of the resource, useful for concurrency control.
etag.title: Etag

id.description: Identifier of the ACL rule, typically formed as '<scopeType>:<value>' (e.g., 'user:someone@example.com', 'group:group@domain.com', 'domain:example.com').
id.title: Id

role.description: The role assigned to the scope. Allowed values: 'none', 'freeBusyReader', 'reader', 'writer', 'owner'.
role.title: Role

scope.description: The extent to which calendar access is granted by this ACL rule.
scope.title: Scope

type.description: The type of the scope. 'default' refers to the public scope (this is the default value). 'user' limits the scope to a single user. 'group' limits the scope to a group. 'domain' limits the scope to a domain.
type.title: Type

value.description: The email address of a user or group, or the name of a domain, depending on the scope type. Omitted when type is 'default'.
value.title: Value
